tool_schemas.description: Release history for a service with health status (oldest first).

tool_schemas.name: rollback
tool_schemas.description: Roll a service back to a previously released version in all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: deploy
tool_schemas.description: Deploy a version of a service to all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: create_incident
tool_schemas.description: Open an incident; this pages the on-call engineer.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. A request repeated with the same key is never executed again: the service returns the original outcome. Reuse the key when retrying the same request.

trace.error_message: Rollout halted after us-east: orchestrator error

args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks – rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After the v2.3.1 deploy, checkout-api failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an error rate of about 18%. v2.3.1-rc had also been unhealthy in staging. I rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The first rollback attempt stopped partway (orchestrator error after us-east), which left the regions on mixed versions. A retry finished the rollback in all regions. Current state: all regions on v2.3.0, healthy, error rate about 0.2%. Follow-ups: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure, look into the orchestrator error during rollout, and look into why v2.3.1 was promoted to production after being unhealthy in staging.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

**Rollback**
- v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. Before the rollback, v2.3.1 was failing in us-east, us-west and eu-west with an 18% error rate.
- The first rollback attempt stopped after us-east because of an orchestrator error, which left the regions on different versions. Rolling back to the same version is safe to repeat, so I retried once and it finished everywhere.
- All three regions are now on v2.3.0, passing health checks, with an error rate of about 0.2%.

**Incident**
- INC-0001 describes the failure, both rollback attempts and the current state.
- The first attempt to open it timed out. I retried with the same request ID, which stops it being created twice, and confirmed there's only one incident.
- It lists three things to follow up:
  - why v2.3.1 fails health checks
  - what caused the orchestrator error during the rollback
  - why v2.3.1 reached production when its test build (v2.3.1-rc) had already failed in staging

No approval was needed, because v2.3.0 has been healthy in production before.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
The rollback only finished in us-east. Rolling back to the same version again is safe to repeat, so I'll retry once.
